name: Chitose (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Chitose city emblem in maroon: a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Chitose, a city in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1952.

features.role: Chitose city emblem — a stylised bird with outstretched wings above a ring
